messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "these symptoms may occur while you take this medicine"
set: ["these symptoms may occur while you take this medicine", "do not breast-feed while taking this medicine", "should not breastfeed while using this medicine", "it may not be safe to breastfeed while using this medicine", "you and your doctor should decide whether you will take this medicine", "symptoms may occur with or without using medication", "tell doctor if become pregnant while taking this medicine", "call your doctor at once if you have these symptoms", "call doctor if liver symptoms occur", "blood tests if liver symptoms occur", "may take up to 8 weeks of using this medicine before ulcer heals", "stop taking this medicine", "this is true even if you have no symptoms", "take the medicine as soon as you can", "may take 1 to 4 days before symptoms improve", "check label of every pain medicine you take"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
